beats.label: S1 · Titanic sinks the heirs
beats.text: The Titanic drowns Lord Grantham's cousin and nephew, the men in line for Downton. A distant middle-class cousin, the lawyer Matthew Crawley, is now the heir presumptive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Matthew as heir is the engine of every marriage and inheritance plot to follow.

beats.label: S1 · Matthew arrives
beats.text: Matthew and his middle-class nurse mother Isobel move into the village and clash with the Crawleys. Violet quietly begins scheming to marry Matthew to Mary.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the Mary–Matthew matchmaking arc that dominates the next two seasons.

beats.label: S1 · Pamuk dies in Mary's bed
beats.text: Turkish diplomat Kemal Pamuk seduces Mary in her bedroom and dies mid-tryst. Anna and Cora help her carry the body back to his own room to avert scandal.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Pamuk secret is the blackmail lever that drives Mary's S2 storyline.

beats.label: S1 · Edith leaks the secret
beats.text: Prodded by O'Brien, kitchen maid Daisy tells Edith what she saw the night Pamuk died. Edith, jealous of Mary, writes to the Turkish ambassador confirming the London rumours.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The sisters' enmity is now structural and shapes every scene between them for years.

beats.label: S1 · Bates and Anna
beats.text: Anna falls in love with valet John Bates, but a criminal past and an estranged wife keep them apart. He fights off schemes by Thomas and O'Brien to have him sacked.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Bates–Vera–Anna triangle is the central downstairs plot of S2 and beyond.

beats.label: S1 · O'Brien's revenge
beats.text: Fearing Cora will replace her, O'Brien leaves soap by the bath. Cora slips and miscarries the son who would have displaced Matthew as heir, and O'Brien is left racked with guilt.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the only obstacle to Matthew's inheritance and sets up O'Brien's guilt-driven arc.

beats.label: S1 · War declared
beats.text: Mary hesitates over Matthew's proposal, still hiding Pamuk. Doubting her motives, he prepares to leave Downton. As the garden party ends, Britain declares war on Germany.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the season with the couple unresolved and the war that defines all of S2 breaking out.

cliffhanger.text: Mary loves Matthew but has not accepted him, terrified he will discover Pamuk. He plans to leave Downton just as Britain declares war on Germany, and Cora has lost the son who would have secured the estate.
questions: Will Matthew and Mary ever marry, or has her silence already cost her him?
Can Mary's secret about Pamuk stay buried once he is gone to the war?
Who inherits Downton if Matthew does not come home?

characters.name: Robert Crawley, Earl of Grantham
characters.line: Master of Downton, an English earl who married American heiress Cora for her fortune; anxious about heirs and about the coming war.

characters.name: Cora, Countess of Grantham
characters.line: American heiress; has just miscarried the son who would have secured the estate.

characters.name: Lady Mary Crawley
characters.line: Robert's eldest daughter; in love with Matthew but paralysed by her Pamuk secret.

characters.name: Lady Edith Crawley
characters.line: Middle daughter, embittered by Mary; exposed the Pamuk rumour out of spite.

characters.name: Lady Sybil Crawley
characters.line: Youngest daughter, drawn to feminism and to Irish chauffeur Branson.

characters.name: Matthew Crawley
characters.line: Manchester lawyer, distant cousin, now presumptive heir; proposed to Mary but plans to leave Downton.

characters.name: Violet, Dowager Countess of Grantham
characters.line: Robert's mother, arch-traditionalist; quietly matchmaking Mary and Matthew.

characters.name: Isobel Crawley
characters.line: Matthew's mother, a middle-class nurse constantly clashing with Violet over the hospital.

characters.name: John Bates
characters.line: Robert's valet and former army batman; a limp and a criminal past shadow him. In love with Anna.

characters.name: Anna Smith
characters.line: Head housemaid, in love with Bates and willing to wait for him.

characters.name: Thomas Barrow
characters.line: Scheming, closeted footman; leaving for the Army Medical Corps as war begins.

characters.name: Sarah O'Brien
characters.line: Cora's lady's maid; caused the miscarriage and is now secretly guilt-ridden.

characters.name: Tom Branson
characters.line: The new Irish chauffeur, a socialist openly in love with Sybil.

beats.label: S2 · War comes to Downton
beats.text: Matthew returns on leave engaged to Lavinia Swire. Mary hides her hurt behind a suitor of her own, the ruthless newspaper mogul Sir Richard Carlisle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Lavinia and Sir Richard, the two obstacles blocking Mary and Matthew for the whole season.

beats.label: S2 · Downton becomes a hospital
beats.text: Downton is converted into a convalescent home for wounded officers. Sybil trains as a nurse and grows closer to Branson, who openly declares his love.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sybil and Branson's romance becomes public, and the house's wartime purpose reshapes the servants.

beats.label: S2 · Matthew wounded, William killed
beats.text: At the front, Matthew is paralysed by a shell that William shields him from. Both come home; William marries Daisy on his deathbed and dies of his injuries.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Matthew's paralysis blocks marriage; William's death sets Daisy's widowed arc.

beats.label: S2 · Pamuk resurfaces, Mary is bought
beats.text: Bates's estranged wife Vera threatens to sell the Pamuk story to the papers. Mary tells all to Sir Richard, who buries the story in exchange for her engagement.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Mary is now permanently bound to a man she does not want, holding her secret.

beats.label: S2 · Matthew walks, Lavinia dies
beats.text: Feeling returns to Matthew's legs and he prepares to wed Lavinia. She overhears him admit he still loves Mary, then dies of Spanish flu; guilt binds him to her memory.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the physical obstacle to Mary but replaces it with a moral one that carries into S3.

beats.label: S2 · Sybil chooses Branson
beats.text: Sybil tries to elope with Branson. Her sisters intercept them, and Sybil returns to plead her case openly; Robert reluctantly gives his blessing to the marriage.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sybil and Branson's union is now family fact, priming S3's Irish–Crawley collision.

beats.label: S2 · Vera frames Bates
beats.text: Vera kills herself to frame Bates for her murder, and he is dragged from Downton in handcuffs. Anna, who had secretly married him only days before, is left waiting.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Season ends with Bates jailed and Anna alone — the driving downstairs plot of S3.

cliffhanger.text: Bates has been arrested for Vera's murder days after secretly marrying Anna. Matthew refuses to reach for Mary, blaming himself for Lavinia's death, while Mary remains bound to Sir Richard's engagement — and to his grip on her Pamuk secret.
questions: Can Bates prove Vera killed herself, or will he hang for her murder?
Will Matthew ever forgive himself enough to reach for Mary?
What price will Sir Richard extract now he holds Mary's secret?

characters.name: Lady Mary Crawley
characters.line: Engaged against her will to Sir Richard Carlisle, still in love with Matthew.

characters.name: Matthew Crawley
characters.line: Walked back from paralysis but guilt-bound to Lavinia's memory and refusing Mary.

characters.name: Sir Richard Carlisle
characters.line: Powerful newspaper mogul, Mary's fiancé and the owner of her Pamuk secret.

characters.name: Lord Grantham (Robert)
characters.line: Master of Downton, humbled by the war and briefly tempted by a housemaid, Jane.

characters.name: Cora, Lady Grantham
characters.line: Countess, recovered from the Spanish flu that killed Lavinia.

characters.name: Lady Edith Crawley
characters.line: Softened by wartime nursing but still a spinster.

characters.name: Lady Sybil Crawley
characters.line: Married Tom Branson and moving with him to Dublin against family wishes.

characters.name: Tom Branson
characters.line: The Irish socialist chauffeur, now Sybil's husband.

characters.name: Violet, Dowager Countess
characters.line: Still scheming, quietly working to break Mary's engagement to Sir Richard.

characters.name: John Bates
characters.line: Arrested for the murder of his wife Vera; awaiting trial.

characters.name: Anna Bates
characters.line: Head housemaid, secretly married to Bates days before his arrest.

beats.label: S3 · Wedding and ruin
beats.text: Mary and Matthew marry as Robert reveals he has lost Cora's American fortune in a failed railway investment. Downton itself may have to be sold to pay creditors.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's financial crisis and the joint estate ownership that follows.

beats.label: S3 · Matthew saves Downton
beats.text: Matthew inherits from Lavinia's father the fortune he had refused to touch. Overcoming his guilt, he pours it into the estate and becomes Robert's joint master.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Matthew is now co-owner of Downton, which structures every family disagreement in S3.

beats.label: S3 · Edith jilted
beats.text: Sir Anthony Strallan bolts from the altar rather than saddle Edith with an old husband. Humiliated, she turns to journalism and begins writing a newspaper column.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Pushes Edith toward the world of magazines and, through them, toward Michael Gregson.

beats.label: S3 · Sybil dies in childbirth
beats.text: Branson flees Ireland; Sybil follows and gives birth to a daughter at Downton. She dies of eclampsia, a death Dr Clarkson says a Caesarean might have prevented.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's biggest loss; defines widowed Branson and his infant Sybbie for every season after.

beats.label: S3 · Bates freed, Tom stays
beats.text: Anna finds evidence that might free Bates, and he is released back to Downton. Branson stays too, and is given the estate agent's job as Robert loosens his grip on management.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Bates and Branson are both permanently reinstalled at Downton going into S4.

beats.label: S3 · Thomas exposed
beats.text: Egged on by O'Brien, Thomas kisses Jimmy in his sleep. Alfred reports him to the police; only Robert's quiet intervention keeps him out of prison.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Thomas's precarious position and Robert's protective bond with him.

beats.label: S3 · Matthew killed at his happiest
beats.text: Mary reveals she has had a minor operation, and she and Matthew can now look forward to starting a family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The death that opens S4 — Mary begins the next season a widow with a newborn.

cliffhanger.text: Downton is saved by Lavinia's father's legacy and now has joint masters in Robert and Matthew, with Tom installed as the estate's agent — but Sybil is dead, and the family is still learning to hold together around her absence.
questions: Can Mary find any reason to live now Matthew is gone?
Who will actually run Downton, and can Robert share it at all?
Will the estate hold together long enough for baby George to inherit?

characters.name: Lady Mary Crawley
characters.line: Newly married to Matthew; after her operation, the two can finally look forward to starting a family.

characters.name: Lord Grantham (Robert)
characters.line: Chastened by his financial recklessness and by Sybil's death; slowly ceding control of the estate.

characters.name: Cora, Lady Grantham
characters.line: Grieving Sybil; her marriage bruised over the birth but reconciled.

characters.name: Lady Edith Crawley
characters.line: Jilted at the altar by Sir Anthony Strallan; now writing a weekly newspaper column.

characters.name: Tom Branson
characters.line: Widower and single father of baby Sybbie; installed as Downton's estate agent.

characters.name: Violet, Dowager Countess
characters.line: Still steering the family after burying her granddaughter.

characters.name: John Bates
characters.line: Freed from prison after Anna finds evidence that might prove him innocent; restored as Robert's valet.

characters.name: Anna Bates
characters.line: Reunited with her husband and back at work at Downton.

characters.name: Thomas Barrow
characters.line: Under-butler; nearly ruined over Jimmy and now quietly indebted to Robert.

characters.name: Mr Carson
characters.line: Butler, quietly protective of Mary.

beats.label: S4 · Mary in mourning, Matthew's letter
beats.text: A letter from Matthew naming Mary his sole heir surfaces months into her mourning. Urged out of black by Violet and Carson, she begins learning the estate alongside Tom.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Mary up as co-owner of Downton and back on the marriage market — the season's engine.

beats.label: S4 · Anna raped
beats.text: During a concert at Downton, Lord Gillingham's valet Green isolates Anna downstairs and rapes her. She swears Mrs Hughes to silence, fearing Bates would kill him and hang.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The crime and its concealment drive the Bates–Anna–Green plot across two full seasons.

beats.label: S4 · Edith pregnant, Gregson gone
beats.text: Edith gives herself to editor Michael Gregson before he leaves for Germany to secure a divorce. He vanishes without word, and she discovers she is carrying his child.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Begins Edith's secret-motherhood arc, which defines her for the rest of the series.

beats.label: S4 · Two men courting Mary
beats.text: Lord Gillingham proposes; Mary refuses, still grieving. Estate inspector Charles Blake arrives to survey the failing landed estates and spars with her from the other direction.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the two suitors whose rivalry structures Mary's S5 plot.

beats.label: S4 · Marigold hidden with the Drewes
beats.text: Rosamund suggests Switzerland and an adoption, but Edith and tenant farmer Mr Drewe devise a scheme for him and his wife to raise little Marigold as a friend's orphan.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The hidden child on the estate is the fuse the whole family walks toward for the next two seasons.

beats.label: S4 · Bates learns; Green dies
beats.text: Mrs Hughes tells Bates that Anna was raped, and he deduces Green was the man. Gillingham dismisses Green at Mary's word; days later Green is killed in Piccadilly.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the murder question that consumes Bates and Anna through S5.

beats.label: S4 · Anna's dread
beats.text: Green dies on Bates's day off — a day he vaguely says he spent in York. Anna is left dreading that her husband travelled to London and murdered her rapist.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Season ends with unspoken suspicion between Anna and Bates that shadows all of S5.

cliffhanger.text: Green is dead in a Piccadilly road accident days after Mary had him dismissed. Bates's alibi is vague and Anna is left in silent dread. A mile from the house, Edith's daughter Marigold is being raised as a farmer's ward.
questions: Did Bates travel to London and murder Green?
Will anyone connect Green's death back to Downton?
How long can Edith bear watching her daughter grow up from a distance?

characters.name: Lady Mary Crawley
characters.line: Out of mourning at last, courted by both Lord Gillingham and Charles Blake.

characters.name: Lord Gillingham (Tony)
characters.line: Persistent suitor who dismissed his valet Green at Mary's word without knowing why.

characters.name: Charles Blake
characters.line: Sharp liberal estate inspector; Gillingham's rival for Mary.

characters.name: Lady Edith Crawley
characters.line: Secretly a mother; her daughter Marigold hidden at the Drewes' farm.

characters.name: Tom Branson
characters.line: Widower estate agent, restless, briefly considering a move to America.

characters.name: John Bates
characters.line: Quietly under suspicion of having murdered Green in London.

characters.name: Anna Bates
characters.line: Rape survivor, now terrified her husband killed her attacker for her.

characters.name: Lord Grantham (Robert)
characters.line: Resistant to Mary taking on the estate; abroad rescuing Cora's playboy brother.

characters.name: Cora, Lady Grantham
characters.line: Steady centre between Robert and Mary as the estate changes hands.

characters.name: Violet, Dowager Countess
characters.line: Weakened by bronchitis but still shaping every family decision.

characters.name: Thomas Barrow
characters.line: Under-butler, coercing new lady's maid Baxter to spy on the family for him.

beats.label: S5 · Mary and Gillingham; the ticket
beats.text: Mary spends a discreet week with Lord Gillingham in Liverpool, then decides she will not marry him. Bates finds the contraceptive Anna procured and grasps what has happened.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Clears Gillingham out of Mary's marriage plot and starts the alibi crisis that indicts Bates.

beats.label: S5 · Green investigation reopens
beats.text: A witness comes forward saying Green was badly treated at Downton and openly disliked Bates. The police close in on Bates as their prime suspect for Green's killing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the S4 murder question in front of Anna and Bates for the whole season.

beats.label: S5 · Gregson dead, Marigold reclaimed
beats.text: News arrives that Michael Gregson was killed by Hitler's men in Munich. Edith inherits his magazine, takes Marigold back from the Drewes, and installs her at Downton as her ward.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Brings Edith's hidden daughter into the house, where the secret can no longer be safely kept.

beats.label: S5 · Bricker in Cora's room
beats.text: Robert returns home to find art historian Simon Bricker in Cora's bedroom uninvited. He throws him out but stays cold with Cora, believing she encouraged the intrusion.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The most serious rupture in the Granthams' marriage, unresolved for most of the season.

beats.label: S5 · Bates innocent, Anna caught
beats.text: Mary confesses she burnt the train ticket that would have proved Bates never went to London. He and Anna reconcile — but a witness now places Anna herself near Green's death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Passes the murder suspicion from Bates to Anna, priming her arrest at season's end.

beats.label: S5 · Rose weds Atticus
beats.text: Rose introduces her new love Atticus Aldridge and his parents Lord and Lady Sinderby to the family. Atticus proposes, and the wider families cautiously accept the engagement.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Moves Rose out of the Downton household and toward a life of her own.

beats.label: S5 · Anna arrested; Robert sees Marigold
beats.text: During Rose's wedding week in London, Inspector Vyner arrests Anna for Green's murder. Watching Edith with her ward, Robert realises Marigold is his own granddaughter.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two live bombs handed to S6: Anna in custody and Robert now holding Edith's secret.

cliffhanger.text: Anna has been arrested for the very murder Bates was cleared of. Robert now privately knows Edith's ward Marigold is his own grandchild, but has said nothing. Rose has married Atticus and moved out of the family.
questions: Can Bates and Mary prove Anna is innocent of Green's murder?
Will Robert force Edith's secret out into the open?
Now that Mary has closed the door on Gillingham, who if anyone will she marry?

characters.name: Lady Mary Crawley
characters.line: Turned down Lord Gillingham; back on the marriage market with no clear suitor.

characters.name: Anna Bates
characters.line: Newly arrested for Green's murder as the season closes.

characters.name: John Bates
characters.line: Cleared by Mary's confession, but shadowed by his wife's arrest.

characters.name: Lady Edith Crawley
characters.line: Publisher and openly Marigold's guardian; her lover Gregson confirmed dead in Munich.

characters.name: Lord Grantham (Robert)
characters.line: Has just realised Marigold is his own grandchild, though has told no one.

characters.name: Cora, Lady Grantham
characters.line: Reconciled with Robert after the Bricker intrusion.

characters.name: Tom Branson
characters.line: Restless widower, quietly planning a move to Boston with baby Sybbie.

characters.name: Violet, Dowager Countess
characters.line: Quietly revisiting an old flame in exiled Prince Kuragin, and helping Edith with the Marigold problem.

characters.name: Isobel Crawley
characters.line: Engaged to Lord Merton over the loud objection of his rude sons.

characters.name: Thomas Barrow
characters.line: Physically ill and desperate after trying to 'cure' his homosexuality.

beats.label: S6 · Anna cleared, blackmail dodged
beats.text: A woman confesses to Green's murder and Anna is freed. A hotel maid then tries to blackmail Mary over the Gillingham tryst; Robert quietly buys her off.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes out the two hangover threats from S5 and clears the field for the season's new stories.

beats.label: S6 · Carsons wed, Tom home
beats.text: Carson and Mrs Hughes marry in the village. During the wedding breakfast, Tom Branson returns unexpectedly from Boston with Sybbie, saying Downton is his home again.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Tom permanently back at Downton and pairs off the two servants at the heart of the house.

beats.label: S6 · Mary meets Henry Talbot
beats.text: Racing driver Henry Talbot visits with Lady Shackleton and falls for Mary; she keeps him at arm's length, frightened of losing another husband to sudden death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the man Mary will end the series married to.

beats.label: S6 · Robert bleeds at dinner
beats.text: Robert's untreated ulcer bursts at dinner and he vomits blood over the table. He survives, but Mary and Tom now openly run the estate to spare him further strain.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Formally hands day-to-day Downton to Mary and Tom, sealing the generational shift.

beats.label: S6 · Edith and Bertie
beats.text: Edith takes a firmer hand at her magazine and grows close to Bertie Pelham, a mild-mannered land agent. He proposes; conscious of Marigold, she asks for time to think.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the Marigold reveal that ruptures the sisters at the season's climax.

beats.label: S6 · Mary destroys Edith
beats.text: Wounded over Henry, Mary blurts out Marigold's parentage in front of Bertie at breakfast. He leaves; Edith retreats to London, vowing she will never forgive her sister.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Marigold secret finally goes off, breaking Edith's engagement and the sisters' relationship.

beats.label: S6 · Weddings and reconciliation
beats.text: Bertie inherits a marquisate. Mary at last agrees to marry Henry Talbot and they wed quickly. Thomas attempts suicide but is saved by Baxter and Andy; the sisters reconcile.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Series-closing marriages and the reconciliation that finally settles the two remaining sisters.

cliffhanger.text: Mary has married Henry Talbot; Anna and Bates are expecting; Thomas has been pulled back from suicide and restored. Bertie has walked away from Edith over Marigold, though the sisters have reconciled — his return is left an open question.
questions: Will Bertie come back to Edith once he has had time to think?
Can Mary and Edith's fragile reconciliation actually hold?
Now the last children are grown, what future is there for Downton itself?

characters.name: Lady Mary Talbot
characters.line: Remarried to racing driver Henry Talbot after weeks of holding him off.

characters.name: Henry Talbot
characters.line: Mary's new husband, a former racing driver haunted by a friend's fatal crash.

characters.name: Lady Edith Crawley
characters.line: Magazine publisher; Marigold now openly her daughter, and Bertie estranged from her.

characters.name: Bertie Pelham, Marquess of Hexham
characters.line: Walked away from Edith when Mary broke the Marigold secret at breakfast.

characters.name: Tom Branson
characters.line: Permanently home at Downton, running the estate day to day alongside Mary.

characters.name: Lord Grantham (Robert)
characters.line: Convalescing after a burst ulcer nearly killed him at dinner.

characters.name: Cora, Lady Grantham
characters.line: President of the newly merged local hospital and the steady centre of the family.

characters.name: Violet, Dowager Countess
characters.line: Lost the hospital battle to Isobel and Cora; away recovering in the south of France.

characters.name: Isobel Crawley
characters.line: Invited to the wedding of Lord Merton's son Larry.

characters.name: Thomas Barrow
characters.line: Pulled back from a suicide attempt by Baxter and Andy; restored to the household.

characters.name: Anna and John Bates
characters.line: Both cleared of Green's murder; expecting a child at last after surgery saved the pregnancy.
